supportingSources.label: Video Games January 1984 Rack 'Em Up review
Rack 'Em Up machine and feature reference

strategy.overview: Rack 'Em Up asks you to light all fifteen numbered pool balls. At the start of a ball, use the right flipper button to rotate the flashing solid-and-stripe pair before the first scored switch fixes the selection. Hit a target or lane while its number flashes to add that ball to the rack; the four top lanes pair 3/11, 4/12, 5/13, and 6/14. After play begins, the spinner and top-left corner pocket can move the flashing selection again. Completing either drop bank advances Bonus X through 3x, 5x, and 10x. Finishing the rack lights Special at the lower-left outlane. The lower-right spot target can also rotate through awards including Spinner, Spot Number, and Extra Ball.
strategy.simpleOverview: Before the first scored switch, use the right flipper to align a flashing number with a reachable lane or target. Hit flashing numbered features to fill all fifteen balls; use the spinner or top-left corner pocket to move the selection later. Clear drop banks for 3x, 5x, and 10x Bonus, and finish the rack to light lower-left outlane Special.
strategy.summary: Use the opening lane-change window instead of accepting a poor flashing pair, then work the safest lit number rather than an unlit target. Take bank completions early for Bonus X and treat the outlane Special as a secondary collect, not a reason to give up control.

quickInfo.name: Choose the Pair
quickInfo.summary: Use right-flipper lane change before the first scored switch.

quickInfo.name: Fill the Rack
quickInfo.summary: Hit each target or lane while its number flashes.

quickInfo.name: Move the Selection
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the spinner or top-left corner pocket.

steps.text: At ball start, use the right flipper button to rotate the flashing solid-and-stripe pair toward the safest reachable feature.
Hit the flashing target or lane to add its numbered ball to the rack; a lit number scores more than an unlit one.
After the opening selection is fixed, shoot the spinner or top-left corner pocket to move the flashing numbers again.
Complete the upper-left or lower-right drop bank to advance Bonus X through 3x, 5x, and 10x.

alternatives.title: Lower-right award target
alternatives.when: Use this when the target is safely reachable and Extra Ball or Spot Number is currently lit.

steps.text: Read the lit award at the lower-right spot target before shooting.
Hit the target for the displayed Spinner, Spot Number, or Extra Ball award, then return to the flashing rack number.
Keep moving the flashing pair and collect every missing numbered ball.
After all fifteen are lit, take the lower-left outlane only when Special is lit and the feed gives a reasonable chance to survive.

machineSetup: Test right-flipper lane change before the first score, the four paired top lanes, numbered targets and lower lanes, spinner, top-left corner pocket, both drop banks, lower-right award target, and lower-left Special outlane.
Check the installed memory difficulty: Normal preserves center lamps, target and rollover lamps, and an uncollected Special between balls; Hardest clears all of that progress.

cautions.issue: Progress memory changes with the installed difficulty level.
cautions.response: Do not assume a nearly complete rack or lit Special will survive the drain; read the lamps on the next ball and rebuild any cleared selection.
